synopsis: A collection of 4 stories: 1. Kaine: Kuro to Shiro no Endorphin (戒音 -dieとliveの脳内麻薬物質-) Shinogu awakens from a coma in a hospital only to find out that his black hair has turned red and long. he looked exactly as his famous rock group vocalist twin brother - Kaine. Kaine was part of a group called Endorphines. Apparently someone tried to kill the two brothers off. However in a car accident Kaine died on the spot while Shinogu was in comatose state. in order to let Endorphines continue, their manager forced Shinogu to take over his brother's place, hoping no one will know the difference. Or will they? Kaine's best friend Die already started to suspect the fake-Kaine. meanwhile, one by one the fans of Endorphins began to commit suicide after listening to their latest CD. Die and 'Kaine' decide to investigate and are determined to find the truth. 2. Magical Mystery Tour (マジカル・ミステリー・ツア) When a normal Japanese high school girl wins an all-expenses-paid trip to LA, it really does seem too good to be true... 3.
